Hi @lucas.barros7 

Please, could you open a ticket in servicedesk? Contest tickets must be opened at the service desk to follow the correct workflow.

We are aware of this situation. This failure occurred due to the expiration of a certificate provided by the structure, but a new certificate has not yet been provided, so the test will continue to fail.

However, when we identify a bug in our platform that affects the execution of automatic FVP, these specific failures are **removed from the set of automatic notifications**, preventing undue notifications to participants until the problem is fixed.

Regards,
